crossRefs.note: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne…
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
That night, Yahweh’s angel went out, and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men…
He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
So Yahweh sent a pestilence on Israel from the morning even to the appointed time; and seventy thousand men died of the…
You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not…
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes…
and all ate the same spiritual food;
